html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · May 9, 2023

On Apr 15, 2023, AI digital-human R&D firm Guizhen Intelligence (硅真智能) raised multi-ten-million RMB angel led by AI-application-focused Jufeng Assets (聚丰资产). Proceeds: AI team + server expansion; Guizhen AI foundation-model training; national dealer-network subsidies; channel ads.

Company focuses on AI content production + interactive experience tech — livestream, brand promo, service efficiency; cut creative/labor cost via proprietary Guizhen LM + core stack; digitize enterprise/industry/society pathways.

Tianyu Digital Culture (天娱数科) IR view: AI × digital humans trend — vivid humanoid dialog beyond text could be another AIGC digital-human milestone. Caveat: ChatGPT still early; GPT-3.5 ~175B params vs human brain ~100B neurons / 100T connections; training needs heavy compute. Uncanny-valley risk as models approach emotional analysis — ethics matter, but silicon evolution currently has priority (Ford T-model vs seatbelt lag analogy in CN).

— END —
